lines.zh: 锚链拖在地上，一路刮石。
lines.en: My anchor chain drags and scrapes the stone.

lines.zh: 我一步的重量，顶你三步。
lines.en: Each of my steps weighs as much as three of yours.

lines.zh: 脚步慢，是因为锚太沉。
lines.en: I walk slowly because the anchor is heavy.

lines.zh: 我绕着石台走，先看一圈。
lines.en: I circle the stone dais, taking one full look.

lines.zh: 地上有旧链痕，是我留下的。
lines.en: Old chain grooves in the floor are mine.

lines.zh: 这条路我走了很多年。
lines.en: I have walked this path for many years.

lines.zh: 锚尖划过去，砖就裂了。
lines.en: The anchor's tip passes and the tiles crack.

lines.zh: 我走在光里，不躲也不藏。
lines.en: I walk in the open; I neither hide nor duck.

lines.zh: 我挪去门前，那里该有人来。
lines.en: I shift to the door; someone should come there.

lines.zh: 石阶太窄，我侧着过去。
lines.en: The steps are narrow; I go sideways.

lines.zh: 我把锚立在脚边，等。
lines.en: I plant the anchor at my feet and wait.

lines.zh: 墙上的刻痕，我一条条数过。
lines.en: I've counted the grooves in the wall, one by one.

lines.zh: 火盆灭了很久，我不去点。
lines.en: The brazier's been out a long while; I leave it.

lines.zh: 这根链子磨得发亮。
lines.en: This chain has worn smooth and bright.

lines.zh: 我坐在门内侧，背对风。
lines.en: I sit inside the door with my back to the wind.

lines.zh: 石缝里长出的苔，我留着。
lines.en: I let the moss grow in the stone seams.

lines.zh: 锚柄上的纹路，被我的手磨平了。
lines.en: The pattern on the handle is worn flat by my grip.

lines.zh: 这地方安静得能听见灰尘落。
lines.en: It's so quiet here I can hear dust settle.

lines.zh: 我在数自己的呼吸。
lines.en: I am counting my own breaths.

lines.zh: 头顶的穹顶有一点渗水。
lines.en: A little water seeps through the dome above.

lines.zh: 门框上那道痕，比我的手臂深。
lines.en: That groove in the doorframe is deeper than my arm.

lines.zh: 锚放倒了，我扶它起来。
lines.en: The anchor tipped; I set it upright again.

lines.zh: 我抬头看穹顶的裂，没修。
lines.en: I look up at the crack in the dome, unrepaired.

lines.zh: 这里的每一块砖我都认得。
lines.en: I know every tile in this place.

lines.zh: 我把整间石厅又走了一遍。
lines.en: I walked the whole stone hall again.

lines.zh: 锚柄压出的印子还在。
lines.en: The mark my anchor left is still there.

lines.zh: 你站在门里，脚还没站稳。
lines.en: You stand in the doorway, not yet steady.

lines.zh: 这身装备，比上一个来的人新。
lines.en: That gear is newer than the last one who came.

lines.zh: 你手里没有钥匙，也没有理由。
lines.en: You hold no key and offer no reason.

lines.zh: 我看着你，等你说明来意。
lines.en: I watch you and wait for your purpose.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在门槛上，退出去。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the threshold; step back.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你比我矮一截。
lines.en: I look down; you stand a head shorter.

lines.zh: 你的指节发白，握得太紧了。
lines.en: Your knuckles have gone white; you're gripping too hard.

lines.zh: 你想拿走的东西，在我身后。
lines.en: What you want lies behind me.

lines.zh: 我带锚，不是为了好看。
lines.en: I carry this anchor, and not for show.

lines.zh: 你走了很远，就为看一眼门？
lines.en: You came far just to look at a door?

lines.zh: 我不拦路，我只守门。
lines.en: I don't block the road; I guard the door.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味，和那些盗墓人一样。
lines.en: You smell like the tomb robbers who came before.

lines.zh: 这一剑，比我想的利。
lines.en: That blade is sharper than I expected.

lines.zh: 锚还在手里，我就没输。
lines.en: As long as the anchor is in hand, I haven't lost.

lines.zh: 我的甲厚，你砍进去两指。
lines.en: My armor is thick; your blade sank two fingers.

lines.zh: 退半步，我换个站位。
lines.en: One step back; I take a new stance.

lines.zh: 石粉从裂口落下来。
lines.en: Stone dust spills from the crack.

lines.zh: 你打中我的关节，手真准。
lines.en: You hit my joint; your aim is good.

lines.zh: 这点痛，我扛过更重的。
lines.en: This pain is nothing; I've borne worse.

lines.zh: 门前的砖被我踩碎了一块。
lines.en: I've cracked a tile at the door.

lines.zh: 你越用力，我越不肯让。
lines.en: The harder you hit, the less I yield.

lines.zh: 我低头，链子绷紧了。
lines.en: I bow my head; the chain pulls taut.

lines.zh: 把东西收起来，我不吃这个。
lines.en: Put that away; I don't eat it.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我的力气不靠它。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me; my strength isn't from it.

lines.zh: 你拿一块面包换门后的东西？
lines.en: You'd trade a loaf for what's behind the door?

lines.zh: 我在等的是对手，不是礼物。
lines.en: What I wait for is an opponent, not a gift.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，会招来虫子。
lines.en: Leave food here and it will draw vermin.

lines.zh: 这一招对野兽有用，对我没有。
lines.en: That works on beasts, not on me.

lines.zh: 我的锚不吃草，也不吃肉。
lines.en: My anchor eats neither grass nor meat.

lines.zh: 别举着它晃，晃得我眼晕。
lines.en: Stop waving it around; it makes my eyes swim.

lines.zh: 你愿意喂我，说明你心虚。
lines.en: Offering me food only shows you're uneasy.

lines.zh: 收回去，留着路上自己吃。
lines.en: Take it back and eat it on your way.

lines.zh: 你撞在我臂上，像撞墙。
lines.en: You bump my arm as if into a wall.

lines.zh: 我退半步，给你让路。
lines.en: Half a pace back, and the way is yours.

lines.zh: 锚头磕地，砖响了一声。
lines.en: The anchor head hits the floor with a clink.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，链子会绊你。
lines.en: Don't walk that close; the chain will trip you.

lines.zh: 门槛低，你低头的时候就低了。
lines.en: The threshold is low; duck when you cross it.

lines.zh: 我这一侧身，用了不少力。
lines.en: Turning sideways like that cost me effort.

lines.zh: 你推不动的，别浪费力气。
lines.en: You can't move me; don't waste your strength.

lines.zh: 我身上是石粉，蹭脏了别怪我。
lines.en: I'm covered in stone dust; don't blame me for stains.

lines.zh: 两个都过不去，你先。
lines.en: We can't both pass; you go first.

lines.zh: 站稳，我的锚还在摆。
lines.en: Stand steady; my anchor is still swinging.

lines.zh: 这里没有第二个守卫者。
lines.en: There is no second guardian here.

lines.zh: 我独自守了很多年。
lines.en: I have guarded alone for many years.

lines.zh: 这种事不在我的职责里。
lines.en: That is not part of my duty.

lines.zh: 石厅太静，我没有同伴。
lines.en: The hall is too quiet; I have no companion.

lines.zh: 要有后来者，也得先过门。
lines.en: If another comes, it must first pass the door.

lines.zh: 我的锚比任何人都陪得久。
lines.en: My anchor has stayed longer than any person.

lines.zh: 守卫者不结伴，这是规矩。
lines.en: Guardians do not pair; that's the rule.

lines.zh: 我数的是砖，不是同伴。
lines.en: I count tiles, not companions.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有回声，不是同类。
lines.en: There's an echo far off, but not kin.

lines.zh: 这一层只需一个人站着。
lines.en: This floor needs only one to stand.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我不捡。
lines.en: I don't pick things up off the floor.

lines.zh: 有人掉了火把，我踢到一边。
lines.en: Someone dropped a torch; I nudge it aside.

lines.zh: 它挡在道上，我搬开。
lines.en: It's in the path, so I move it.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，自己捡。
lines.en: You dropped that; pick it up yourself.

lines.zh: 碎片我留着，是墙上的。
lines.en: I keep the shards; they came from the wall.

lines.zh: 我手里只拿锚，别的都不拿。
lines.en: My hands hold only the anchor, nothing else.

lines.zh: 那袋东西不属于我。
lines.en: That bag is not mine.

lines.zh: 拾起来也没用，我用不上。
lines.en: Picking it up wouldn't help; I couldn't use it.

lines.zh: 地上的金币，我踩过去。
lines.en: I walk over the gold coins on the floor.

lines.zh: 留下它，主人会回来找。
lines.en: Leave it; its owner may come back for it.

lines.zh: 你踏过门槛之后，就算闯入。
lines.en: Once you cross the threshold, you've trespassed.

lines.zh: 我等你把火点着，再动手。
lines.en: I wait for you to light the fire, then move.

lines.zh: 门后的东西，你带不走。
lines.en: What lies behind the door leaves with no one.

lines.zh: 这一层归我守，向来如此。
lines.en: This floor is mine to guard, as always.

lines.zh: 你的同伴退了出去。
lines.en: Your companions have backed out.

lines.zh: 我抬起锚，就是最后一句劝。
lines.en: I lift the anchor as my last warning.

lines.zh: 你把手伸向那扇门了。
lines.en: You've reached your hand toward that door.

lines.zh: 很多年前也有人这样站着。
lines.en: Years ago, someone stood just like that.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只守这一间。
lines.en: I don't chase; I guard only this room.

lines.zh: 你要的东西，在我锚后面。
lines.en: What you want sits behind my anchor.

lines.zh: 我不认得你，也无需认得。
lines.en: I don't know you, and I don't need to.

lines.zh: 进来的人，一般不会再出去。
lines.en: Those who come in generally don't leave.

lines.zh: 锚落地，就是开始了。
lines.en: The anchor hits the ground, and we begin.

lines.zh: 退后三步，我还可以当作没看见。
lines.en: Step back three paces and I'll let it pass.

lines.zh: 你把火把插在门框上了。
lines.en: You stuck your torch in the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我听见你把盾扣紧。
lines.en: I hear you buckling that shield tight.

lines.zh: 站住，这门后没有路。
lines.en: Halt. There is no path past this door.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，比上一批新。
lines.en: Your iron is newer than the last batch.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就砸盾。
lines.en: Raise your shield and I'll break the shield.

lines.zh: 锚的弧线长，你得退得远些。
lines.en: The anchor's arc is long; you'd better step wide.

lines.zh: 我从上面压下来，别贴墙。
lines.en: I come down from above; don't hug the wall.

lines.zh: 你换手的时候，脚步会慢。
lines.en: When you switch hands, your feet slow down.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，第四下就动。
lines.en: I count your breaths; I move on the fourth.

lines.zh: 这里地滑，跑起来会摔。
lines.en: The floor is slick; running will drop you.

lines.zh: 门框困住你的身位，正好。
lines.en: The doorway pins your stance; that suits me.

lines.zh: 你绕左，我就在左边等。
lines.en: Circle left, and I'll be waiting on the left.

lines.zh: 我不急，锚比我更沉得住。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; the anchor is more patient than I.

lines.zh: 你退到台阶，我不下台阶。
lines.en: Fall back to the steps; I don't leave them.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼睛，别看我手。
lines.en: Watch my eyes, not my hands.

lines.zh: 我把你往门里逼，那里没有退路。
lines.en: I push you toward the inner door, where there's no escape.

lines.zh: 链子在我手里，转一圈要半息。
lines.en: The chain turns in my hand in half a breath.

lines.zh: 等你的护甲磕到石柱。
lines.en: I wait until your armor scrapes the pillar.

lines.zh: 你举盾的手抖了一下。
lines.en: The hand holding your shield just shook.

lines.zh: 锚柄横过来，你的退路就短了。
lines.en: Anchor across, and your way out shrinks.

lines.zh: 我贴着石柱走，只为挡住你。
lines.en: I hug the pillar only to cut you off.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在穹顶下太响。
lines.en: Your steps echo too loudly under this dome.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，就进我的弧线。
lines.en: One more step and you are in my arc.

lines.zh: 我等你出剑，再动锚。
lines.en: I wait for your sword, then lift the anchor.

lines.zh: 锚柄横扫，落在你腰侧。
lines.en: The anchor's handle sweeps into your side.

lines.zh: 锚背压下来，弯的是你的盾。
lines.en: The anchor's back comes down, and your shield bends.

lines.zh: 锚头砸地，石头碎片飞起来。
lines.en: The anchor head slams down and stone chips fly.

lines.zh: 我用肩撞你，比锚更直接。
lines.en: I hit you with my shoulder, more direct than the anchor.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，手该麻了。
lines.en: You blocked one; your arm must be numb.

lines.zh: 我起手慢，落下只在一瞬。
lines.en: My windup is slow; the fall takes an instant.

lines.zh: 锚尖勾住你的甲，往我这拉。
lines.en: The anchor's tip hooks your armor and pulls you in.

lines.zh: 这一击我留了力，你还有机会。
lines.en: I held back on that one; you still have a chance.

lines.zh: 你退到石阶上，那就站稳了。
lines.en: You've reached the steps; now find your footing.

lines.zh: 我的锚换手，你看清楚了。
lines.en: I shift the anchor between hands; watch closely.

lines.zh: 石厅的回声大，听不清脚下。
lines.en: The hall echoes so much you can't hear your feet.

lines.zh: 砸空一次，地上多了个坑。
lines.en: I miss once and leave a new pit in the floor.

lines.zh: 你的剑太短，够不到我。
lines.en: Your blade is too short to reach me.

lines.zh: 我收锚的时候，就是下一次开始。
lines.en: When I draw the anchor back, the next one starts.

lines.zh: 石厅的灯自己亮了，我醒了。
lines.en: The lamps in the hall light themselves; I wake.

lines.zh: 我从石台下来，一步一震。
lines.en: I step down from the dais; the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 锚还在原位，没有生锈。
lines.en: The anchor is still in place, not rusted.

lines.zh: 这一觉睡得太久了。
lines.en: I've slept far too long.

lines.zh: 我数了数落下的灰，很厚。
lines.en: I gauge the fallen dust; it's thick.

lines.zh: 有人把我放进了刷怪蛋里。
lines.en: Someone has put me inside a spawn egg.

lines.zh: 脚下的砖还是我熟悉的那块。
lines.en: The tile under my feet is the one I know.

lines.zh: 先把链子理顺，再站起来。
lines.en: Let me straighten the chain before I stand.

lines.zh: 穹顶的裂缝又宽了一指。
lines.en: The crack in the dome has widened a finger's width.

lines.zh: 门还关着，那就好。
lines.en: The door is still shut; good.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，石厅就低了半分。
lines.en: When I stand, the hall seems to sink a little.

lines.zh: 远处的脚步，是新的。
lines.en: Those footsteps far off are new.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整面墙盖住了。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole wall.

lines.zh: 醒来的第一件事，是握手柄。
lines.en: The first thing on waking is gripping the handle.

lines.zh: 石台裂开，我从里面坐起。
lines.en: The slab splits and I sit up from it.

lines.zh: 锚柄上的灰，我一手抹掉。
lines.en: One swipe clears the dust off the handle.

lines.zh: 火盆自己亮了，不是有人点。
lines.en: The brazier lit itself, no one touched it.

lines.zh: 我数了数这一层，没少东西。
lines.en: I counted this floor; nothing is missing.

lines.zh: 谁把我的链子挪过位置。
lines.en: Someone moved my chain from its place.

lines.zh: 醒来的这一刻，最安静。
lines.en: This moment of waking is the quietest.

lines.zh: 火在我甲上烧，烟从缝里出。
lines.en: Fire burns on my armor; smoke leaks from the seams.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音，比你喊的响。
lines.en: My landing is louder than your shout.

lines.zh: 水到腰，我的锚更沉了。
lines.en: Water reaches my waist and the anchor grows heavier.

lines.zh: 炸药的力气，还推不动我。
lines.en: Explosives still aren't enough to move me.

lines.zh: 箭插在甲上，像根针。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my armor like a pin.

lines.zh: 咒语打在石头上，散成光点。
lines.en: The spell hits stone and scatters into sparks.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只站着守门。
lines.en: I don't eat; I only stand and guard.

lines.zh: 雷落在穹顶上，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the dome; I don't move.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有门可守。
lines.en: There is no door to guard in the void.
